title: ComplianceEvent
description: Structured event emitted by the hooks contract for the audit bridge. Only state-transition events exist (freeze/unfreeze, bind/unbind, config changes); per-operation approvals are never emitted because any contract can invoke the hook surface and reverts discard events. Events carry addresses and booleans only — never amounts or private financial data.

policy.description: The newly configured policy address, or null (compliance_config_changed only).

sac_passthrough.description: The newly configured SAC-passthrough flag (compliance_config_changed only).

ledger.description: Optional ledger sequence recorded by the indexer/audit consumer.

address.description: Stellar address: G… for accounts, C… for contracts.
